lines.t: Use: Assembles a camp chair that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2% increased critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, mutually exclusive with Moonkin Aura.
Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Places a Field Guide that allows players to read it and gain Track Beasts, and provides all the benefits of a Camp Chair. Requires a Campfire nearby.
May be placed over a Camp Chair to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Places a Trapper's Workbench containing 1 trap, and provides all the benefits of a Camp Chair. Requires a Campfire nearby.
May be placed over a Camp Chair to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
